picks.title: Floquet ground state order
picks.authors: Suman Mondal · Paul M. Schindler · Marin Bukov
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other); Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)
picks.why_zh: 几何 Floquet 理论给出平均能量算符基态上的稳定量子序（异于预热），并发展 MPS 变分算法，在 >100 自旋非可积驱动链见能隙、面积律纠缠的 Floquet 基态与时间晶体序——Floquet × 张量网络 × 多体非平衡。
picks.summary_zh: 干净相互作用周期驱动系统通常热化到无特征无穷高温态，难以形成稳定有序。作者将演化分解为几何与平均能量动力学，用几何 Floquet 理论定义 Floquet 基态，并导出可计算大体系 Floquet 基态的变分原理与矩阵乘积态算法。在百自旋以上非可积驱动链中，数值给出扩展参数区内有能隙、面积律纠缠的 Floquet 基态：既可承载修饰后的平衡序（如 Floquet 反铁磁），也可承载固有非平衡序（如基态时间晶体）。该序由有限平均能量能隙保护，能隙闭合对应相变。作者把 Floquet 物态拆为平衡与非平衡要素：固定时刻的 Floquet 基态属平衡相，非平衡内容全由驱动的几何 holonomy 产生；并指出准局域反绝热驱动可抑制加热，论证 Floquet 基态何以规避本征态热化假说。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Clean, interacting, periodically driven systems are believed to thermalize to featureless, infinite-temperature states that preclude the formation of stable ordered states. Here, we show stable quantum order, distinct from prethermal order, and its phase transitions in the ground state of the average-energy operator. Decomposing the time evolution into geometric and average-energy dynamics, we apply Geometric Floquet theory to identify the Floquet ground state. We derive a general variational principle to compute the Floquet ground state in large interacting periodically driven systems, and use it to develop a matrix product state algorithm. In driven nonintegrable chains of more than 100 interacting spins, our numerical simulations exhibit a gapped, area-law entangled Floquet ground state in extended parameter regimes; the ground-state manifold can support both dressed equilibrium order (e.g., Floquet antiferromagnets) and inherently nonequilibrium order (e.g., ground-state time crystals). This quantum order is protected by a finite average-energy gap, which closes at phase transition points upon changing model parameters. We decompose Floquet phases of matter into their equilibrium and nonequilibrium elements: whereas the Floquet ground state at any fixed time is a representative of an equilibrium phase of matter, the nonequilibrium content is entirely produced by the drive holonomy and is geometric. Finally, we identify quasilocal counterdiabatic driving as a mechanism for the stability against heating of gapped Floquet ground states in nonintegrable quantum systems, and argue why Floquet ground states evade the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis. Our work enables the study of interacting nonequilibrium matter deep into the many-body regime, and lays the foundations for the engineering of strongly correlated ordered quantum states.

picks.title: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
picks.authors: Xinhai Tu · Di Wang · Yuxuan Mu · Xiangang Wan
picks.why_zh: 把含 SOC 的 DM/Gamma/单离子各向异性纳入推广自旋群对称分类（6 个自旋-only + 161 个非平凡自旋群），并用于磁子热导与自旋电导张量；文中明确覆盖交错磁中的相对论磁子输运——altermagnetism × 磁子拓扑/自旋电子学对称。
picks.summary_zh: 自旋群是各向同性 Heisenberg 模型中自旋与晶格可分离时的自然对称框架，已广泛用于电子能带、磁子带拓扑与输运。真实磁子哈密顿量还含自旋轨道耦合诱导的各向异性项（DM、Gamma、单离子各向异性），并出现于交错磁的相对论磁子输运；这类体系常被简化为常规磁群描述。作者系统建立面向磁子的推广自旋群：先分类 Heisenberg/DM/Gamma/SIA 对称性，得到 6 个自旋-only 群与共 161 个非平凡自旋群；磁有序相的对称性再由自旋哈密顿量母群自发破缺得到，并枚举有序态下的大量非平凡自旋群。最后将框架用于磁子热导与自旋电导张量，给出全部对称允许形式，统一有无 SOC 情形下的磁子响应约束。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.

picks.title: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
picks.why_zh: 有限宽 d 波交错磁量子环的相干双端输运：Aharonov–Bohm 精确 h/e 周期与半磁通透射零点，晶轴旋转翻转透射自旋，亚特斯拉场可达 |P_T|>0.99——altermagnetism × 介观干涉自旋滤波。
picks.summary_zh: 作者研究非磁导线耦合的有限宽 d 波交错磁量子环相干输运。受限 Aharonov–Bohm 磁通保持精确 h/e 周期；对称单模几何下给出精确半磁通透射零点。垂直场按有效面积移动干涉图案，交错磁劈裂把共同零点拆成自旋依赖节点。旋转晶体取向可翻转透射自旋，而 θ_A=π/4 镜面取向精确自旋简并。对 50 nm 参考环，亚特斯拉场即可给出 |P_T|>0.99 窗口，其中最易实现的仅需均匀场、无需受限磁通。有限偏压、温度、无序、Zeeman 与自旋守恒电压探针计算表明，极化度比单个相干共振振幅更稳健。结果把干涉节点位置、磁通周期与晶控自旋极化标为交错磁介观干涉仪的可用实验指纹。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width $d$-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly $h/e$ periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area $A_{\rm eff}=1.0342\,\pi r_0^2$ and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation $\theta_A=\pi/4$ is exactly spin degenerate. For a $50$~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with $|P_T|>0.99$, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.

picks.title: Steering of topological criticality in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain via non-Hermitian substitutional impurities
picks.authors: Juan A. Cañas · Guo-Qing Zhang · A. Martín-Ruiz
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 有限浓度非厄米替位杂质通过打破非互易跃迁内部对称，确定性地宏观平移 SSH 拓扑临界点，并可扩展/压缩拓扑相；伴随实→复谱跃迁与非厄米趋肤效应——非厄米 × 拓扑临界。
picks.summary_zh: 作者研究一维 SSH 链在有限浓度非厄米替位杂质下的拓扑相。核心机制是：引入位点依赖的非互易胞内/胞间跃迁后，打破杂质非互易跃迁的内部结构对称，可把临界点做定向宏观位移，从而仅靠局域缺陷不对称就能受控扩展或压缩拓扑相区。有限尺寸标度给出关联长度临界指数 ν≈1.455（对称）与 ν≈1.397（不对称），确认偏离纯净 SSH 普适类，且高缺陷密度下指数发散。文中还报告杂质诱导的实→复谱跃迁，并由非厄米趋肤效应几何刻画。结论是孤立非厄米不对称可协同、确定性地平移宏观拓扑保护边界。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We investigate the topological phase in a one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain in the presence of a finite concentration of non-Hermitian substitutional impurities. Our primary focus is the discovery of a deterministic mechanism to actively reconfigure the topological phase boundaries by introducing site-dependent, non-reciprocal intracell and intercell hopping amplitudes. Specifically, breaking the internal structural symmetry of the non-reciprocal impurity hoppings induces a targeted macroscopic displacement of the critical point. This mechanism allows for the controlled expansion or compression of the topological phase strictly via local defect asymmetry. We validate this boundary displacement through finite-size scaling analysis. The extracted correlation length critical exponents ($\nu \approx 1.455$ and $\nu \approx 1.397$ for symmetric and asymmetric configurations, respectively) confirm a disorder-induced departure from the pristine SSH universality class, with the exponent diverging at high defect densities. We also report an impurity-induced real-to-complex spectral transition geometrically characterized by the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect. Ultimately, our results establish how isolated non-Hermitian asymmetries cooperatively interact to deterministically shift macroscopic topological protection.

picks.title: Systematic Truncated Wigner Approximation for Open Spin Systems Reveals Long-Range Order Far from Equilibrium
picks.authors: Igor Timofeev · Dawid A. Hryniuk · Marzena H. Szymańska
picks.why_zh: 由 Lindblad 方程的精确 Stratonovich–Weyl 演化系统导出连续 SU(2) 协变截断 Wigner 框架，可处理任意自旋 S 的开放自旋系统，并在 400 格点二维耗散各向异性 XY 中揭示远离平衡长程序——开放系统 × 非平衡多体。
picks.summary_zh: 长程相互作用可保护耗散序免受涨落破坏，但二维何时成立对既有多体方法仍困难。作者发展连续 SU(2) 协变截断 Wigner 框架：把问题映射为每格点一个 Bloch 球的随机动力学；由 Lindblad 方程的精确 Stratonovich–Weyl 演化系统导出，为任意自旋 S 同时生成漂移与库噪声。相对精确对角化与张量网络基准，该方法能可靠描述非平衡动力学与稳态。应用于 400 格点二维耗散各向异性 XY 晶格，揭示远离平衡的长程序何时被长程相互作用保护。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Long-range interactions can protect dissipative order against fluctuations, but determining when they do so in two dimensions remains out of reach for existing many-body methods. We develop a continuous SU(2)-covariant truncated-Wigner framework that maps the problem onto stochastic dynamics with one Bloch sphere per site. Derived systematically from the exact Stratonovich-Weyl evolution of the Lindblad equation, it generates both drift and reservoir noise for arbitrary spin $S$. Benchmarks against exact and tensor-network calculations validate its description of non-equilibrium dynamics and steady states. Applied to 400-site two-dimensional dissipative anisotropic XY lattices, our method reveals physics missed by mean-field and perturbative approaches: vortex-antivortex proliferation destroys the predicted staggered-XY phase for nearest-neighbour coupling, whereas algebraically decaying interactions stabilize an extended $\mathbb{Z}_2$-ordered phase. We obtain the first beyond-mean-field steady-state phase diagram of the long-range interacting model, revealing reentrant loss of order at strong coupling and closure of the ordered region beyond $\alpha\approx 3.5$. Our new method provides a scalable route to strongly correlated driven-dissipative systems with long-range interactions, higher-dimensional geometries, spin-boson couplings, and spins beyond one half, relevant to modern experiments with magnetic atoms and polar molecules in optical lattices and tweezer arrays.

picks.title: Dynamical Mean-Field Theory for Real Materials using Variational Quantum Compressed Time Evolution on a Quantum Computer
picks.authors: Stefan Wolf · Johannes Selisko · Timo Eckstein 等
picks.why_zh: DFT+DMFT 杂化流程用变分量子压缩时间演化作杂质求解器，在 IBM Heron 上算 CaCuO₂ 时域 Green 函数并提取态密度特征；自洽精度仍超现有 NISQ——量子 ML/变分量子 × 强关联材料。
picks.summary_zh: 作者设计面向真实材料的杂化量子–经典流程：结合 DFT 与动力学平均场，用基于变分量子压缩时间演化的量子算法作杂质求解器，在 IBM Heron 器件上计算时依赖 Green 函数。借助误差缓解与 Lehmann 表象拟合，从可及时间窗口提取态密度，并成功分辨谱函数特征峰。然而达到完整 DMFT 自洽所需数值精度仍超出当前硬件能力，表明实用材料级 DMFT 应用仍有待后 NISQ 硬件。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We design a hybrid quantum-classical computational workflow, combining density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory, to investigate the electronic properties of CaCuO2, a parent structure of high-temperature cuprate superconductors. Our approach uses a quantum algorithm as an impurity solver that is based on variational quantum compressed time evolution to compute the time-dependent Greens function on an IBM Heron quantum device. Utilizing error mitigation techniques and a Lehmann representation fitting procedure, we extract the density of states from the signal in the accessible time regime. Despite the significant challenges rooted in the residual imprecision of currently accessible NISQ devices, we successfully resolve the characteristic features of the spectral function. However, we find that the required numerical accuracy for full DMFT self-consistency exceeds current hardware capabilities, indicating that practical real-material DMFT applications will necessitate post-NISQ hardware developments.

picks.title: Field theories and critical excitations at anyon condensation transitions
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)
picks.why_zh: 从母拓扑序与凝聚子范畴数据出发，给出任意子凝聚相变的两类互补刻画：适配 SymTFT 的 2+1D Ginzburg–Landau 构造，以及连续转变上哪些点/环激发临界的判据——任意子凝聚 × 拓扑相变。
picks.summary_zh: 任意子凝聚相变（尤其非阿贝尔）仍难刻画。作者提出两套互补方案，从母拓扑序与凝聚子的范畴数据提取转变信息。其一把 SymTFT 设定下 1+1D 的 Ginzburg–Landau 程序推广到 2+1D 任意子凝聚，适用于凝聚任意子具有整数量子维数的情形。其二给出连续转变上临界点/环激发的判据：先确定哪些任意子环在全程保持凝聚，其余环变临界；点激发若与每个凝聚环编织平凡则亦临界。文中在若干阿贝尔与非阿贝尔例子上演示两套方案。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Anyon condensation transitions remain challenging to characterize especially when the condensing anyons are non-abelian. We develop two complementary approaches for extracting information about the transition from the categorical data of the parent topological order and the condensate. The first adapts a Ginzburg-Landau procedure developed for $1+1$D transitions in the SymTFT setting to $2+1$D anyon condensation transitions. The construction applies when the anyons participating in the condensate have integer quantum dimensions. The second gives a criterion for identifying which point and loop excitations become critical at a continuous transition. The key step is to determine which anyon loops remain condensed throughout. All other loops become critical, while a point excitation becomes critical if it braids trivially with every condensed loop. We illustrate both proposals in several abelian and non-abelian examples.

picks.title: Capturing Open Quantum System Dynamics with Compact Dressed Hamiltonians
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)
picks.why_zh: 反应坐标 + 极化子变换后再截断集体玻色模的紧凑 dressed 哈密顿量，以更小 Hilbert 空间逼近强耦合结构库动力学，并可直接读 Liouvillian 谱与慢模——开放系统 × 强耦合主方程。
picks.summary_zh: 作者推进紧凑 dressed 哈密顿量（CDH）框架，用于强耦合结构玻色环境中的开放系统动力学。先做反应坐标映射与极化子变换，把强系统–环境杂化纳入 dressed 表象，再截断集体玻色模，从而用远少于原表象的态数捕获动力学；残余环境用弱耦合马尔可夫主方程处理。对单自旋、耦合自旋与自旋系综的自旋–玻色型模型，在共振/失谐与弱到强耦合下与 HEOM 及收敛反应坐标结果对比，显示 CDH 能系统逼近振荡频率、弛豫与长时间布居，并捕获库介导相互作用、自旋同步与集体发射迹象。此外可直接访问 Liouvillian 谱与本征模，慢动力学模在 CDH 中收敛快，便于不依赖拟合时间观测量即识别弛豫时标。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: We advance the compact dressed Hamiltonian (CDH) framework to simulate the dynamics of open quantum systems strongly coupled to structured bosonic environments. The CDH approach combines reaction-coordinate mapping with a polaron transformation, incorporating strong system-environment hybridization into a dressed representation before truncating the collective bosonic mode. As a result of this truncation, dynamical features are captured with substantially fewer states than in the original representation. The residual environment is treated using a weak-coupling Markovian quantum master equation. We benchmark the method for spin-boson-type models including a single spin, coupled spins, and spin ensembles, considering both resonant and off-resonant regimes and weak to strong system-bath coupling. Comparisons with hierarchical equations of motion and converged reaction-coordinate calculations demonstrate that the CDH representation systematically approaches the reference dynamics with a compact Hilbert space, accurately reproducing oscillation frequencies, relaxation behavior, and long-time populations over a broad parameter regime. The method further captures cooperative phenomena, including bath-mediated interactions, synchronization between spins, and signatures for collective emission. Beyond efficient time propagation, the CDH framework provides direct access to the spectrum and eigenmodes of the Liouvillian. We demonstrate that slow dynamical modes converge rapidly in the CDH representation, enabling identification of relaxation timescales without fitting time-dependent observables. As a whole, the CDH framework provides an efficient and physical description of strongly coupled open quantum-system dynamics.

picks.title: Orbital-angular-momentum control of localized Floquet states and photocurrents in Weyl semimetals
picks.authors: Kyle S. Netherwood · Juan I. Aranzadi · Nils Jacobsen 等
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 涡旋光束的轨道角动量在 Weyl 半金属中产生高度局域的 Floquet 涡旋态与环流光电流；连续 BdG 径向方程与 Wilson 格点计算一致支持 OAM 作为局域载流态的可调旋钮——Floquet × 拓扑 Weyl × 结构光。
picks.summary_zh: 结构光不仅可通过偏振、还可通过空间剖面与轨道角动量（OAM）调控量子材料。作者建立涡旋光束驱动 Weyl 半金属的实空间理论，表明光学 OAM 可生成高度局域的 Floquet 涡旋态并伴强环流光电流。利用柱对称导出类似 BdG 的径向方程，按角动量分辨态并追踪其在光修饰 Weyl 锥之间的演化；对 Laguerre–Gaussian 束，空间变化驱动导致局域涡旋态与体态强杂化。Wilson 格点表述保留完整二维空间结构，可直接算局域光电流：两方法一致确认束轴附近的 OAM 诱导涡旋态，且低角动量、最局域涡旋模携带显著强于扩展表面态的环流电流密度。
picks.zotero_note: 桌面 DESKTOP-00O6NSD 未在线，本次未做 Zotero 核对。
picks.abstract: Structured light provides a route to controlling quantum materials not only through its polarization, but also through its spatial profile and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We develop real space theories of a Weyl semimetal driven by a vortex beam and show that optical OAM generates highly localized Floquet vortex states with pronounced circulating photocurrents. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, we derive a Bogoliubov-de Gennes-like radial equation that resolves the states by angular momentum and reveals their evolution between the light-dressed Weyl cones. For Laguerre-Gaussian beams, the spatially varying drive produces strong hybridization between localized vortex states and bulk states. We complement this continuum description with a Wilson-lattice formulation that retains the full two-dimensional spatial structure and enables direct calculation of local photocurrents. Both approaches consistently identify OAM-induced vortex states localized around the beam axis. The lattice calculation further shows that these states support substantially stronger circulating current densities than the more extended surface states, with the largest current densities associated with the most strongly localized, low-angular-momentum vortex modes. Our results establish optical OAM as a tunable control parameter for creating and manipulating localized current-carrying states in Weyl systems and provide a real-space framework for studying photocurrents generated by spatially structured light.

picks.title: Zeeman Quantum Geometry of the Layer Pseudo-spin
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)
picks.why_zh: 定义层赝自旋的量子几何（带间 Berry 联络与层矩阵元混合张量），给出与普通自旋不同的选择定则；扭曲双层 MoTe₂ 上量化局域偶极调制与整流/螺旋/三次谐波净响应——量子几何 × 莫尔层自由度。
picks.summary_zh: 位置依赖层间隧穿耦合的二维层可把层赝自旋极化当作可控内禀自由度。作者引入该层赝自旋的量子几何：由带间 Berry 联络与层矩阵元构成的混合张量，支配对振荡面内电场的响应。因层赝自旋在三重旋转下是 Ising 型标量不变量，其选择定则不同于赝矢量自旋。最小两带模型中层赝自旋量子度规与 Zeeman–Berry 曲率非零，但布里渊区积分消失；故面内驱动在线性阶不改变空间平均极化，却印上可被层分辨隧穿成像的莫尔周期胞内图案。对扭曲双层 MoTe₂，文中量化局域偶极调制，并指出更高阶出现净响应的整流、螺旋奇与三次谐波通道。

picks.abstract: Two-dimensional layers coupled by position-dependent interlayer tunnelling host a layer pseudo-spin whose polarization is a controllable internal degree of freedom. We introduce the quantum geometry of this layer pseudo-spin: a mixed tensor formed from the interband Berry connection and the layer matrix element, which governs the response to an oscillating in-plane electric field. Because the layer pseudo-spin is an Ising-type scalar invariant under threefold rotation, its selection rules differ from those of a pseudovector spin. In a minimal two-band model, the layer-pseudo-spin quantum metric and Zeeman--Berry curvature are nonzero, while their zone integrals vanish. An in-plane drive therefore leaves the spatially averaged polarization unchanged at linear order but imprints a moiré-periodic intracell pattern, directly imageable by layer-resolved tunnelling. For twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer, we quantify the local dipole modulation and identify the rectified, helicity-odd, and third-harmonic channels through which a net response appears at higher order.

picks.title: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
picks.authors: Zhi-Qiang Zhang · Shuguang Cheng · Hongfang Liu 等
picks.subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)
picks.why_zh: 预测由 Chern 矢量 C=(0,m,n) 保护的三维量子霍尔：全局拓扑强制 mL_y+nL_z 集体量子化，霍尔电导 G_xy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h——三维 Chern 矢量拓扑 × 量子霍尔。
picks.summary_zh: 三维量子霍尔由 Chern 矢量而非单一陈数刻画；以往量子化输运多讨论仅一个非零分量的特殊情形，更一般 Chern 矢量态如何保护量子化仍是问题。作者预言由 C=(0,m,n) 保护的三维量子霍尔效应：对尺寸 L_y、L_z 的样品，全局拓扑强制 mL_y+nL_z 集体量子化，尽管单个边缘模对无序脆弱。这表明稳健量子化可作为统一手性网络的整体性质出现。集体响应表现为霍尔电导 G_xy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h，同时依赖 Chern 矢量分量与样品尺寸；并讨论候选材料以利实验观测。

picks.abstract: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by $\mathbf{C}=(0,m,n)$. For samples with dimensions $L_y$ and $L_z$, global topology enforces collective quantization of $mL_y+nL_z$, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance $G_{xy}=\pm(mL_y+nL_z)e^2/h$, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.
